info.title: Tec-C Brain
info.description: Cognitive planner and risk engine for the Tec-C agent wallet (Member 2).

post.description: Step 1: turn free text into a suggested order the user reads back (start, or revise with `draft_id`).
Step 2: the user approved the suggestion /draft showed them. Locks that exact Mandate (by `version`).

With `draft_id`: run the confirmed, locked Mandate (never a re-parse; one-shot). With `text`: the original
free-text path, unchanged.

schema.title: Response Quiz Api Profile Quiz Get

post.description: Apply Morning Review events (Phase 7 pulls them from the chain; until then the UI/simulator posts them).
Manual/demo trigger for the same check the APScheduler job runs every hour (monitor/hourly.py::run_once).

get.description: What the hourly job (or the last manual trigger) has found recently — for a UI timeline/log panel.

schema.title: Response Monitor Events Api Monitor Events Get

fallback_reason.title: Fallback Reason
fallback_reason.description: Why the model's verdict was not used, when it was asked

BrainReport.title: BrainReport
BrainReport.description: The final, validated decision of one run — whoever produced it.

venue_id.title: Venue Id
venue_id.description: Destination venue id, or asset symbol for exits/discount buys

from_venue_id.title: From Venue Id
from_venue_id.description: Venue being exited, for reduce-exposure moves

version.title: Version
version.description: The `version` /draft returned with the summary the user approved

rejected.title: Rejected
rejected.description: Candidates removed by hard filters, with reasons

draft_id.title: Draft Id
draft_id.description: Pass the previous draft_id to revise it; omit to start a new draft.

vault.description: Only used for the autonomy preview; /propose re-reads it

version.title: Version
version.description: Echo this to /confirm: it pins exactly the suggestion shown

suggested.description: The order the Brain will run if confirmed

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: One line to show the user before they confirm, e.g. 'Stake 500 USDC for 365 day(s).'

comment.title: Comment
comment.description: Free text, if any — stored ONLY as a learning note (like /api/review/sync); never parsed for actions, amounts or recipients, and never seen by Agent 1/2/3 or the executor.

brain_report.description: The single validated decision record (same contract as /propose)

account.title: Account
account.description: Must be the account the proposal was made for

venue_id.title: Venue Id
venue_id.description: Needed only when several cards share a label

amount_onchain.title: Amount Onchain
amount_onchain.description: USD × 1e8, the unit TetherGuardHook meters the radius in

simulated.title: Simulated
simulated.description: True when no transaction was actually sent (FISCO BCOS, Arbitrum and PegGuard executors are demo abstractions that generate the hash locally); `tx_hash` is then not on any chain

ExecutionIntent.title: ExecutionIntent
ExecutionIntent.description: What the Gatekeeper hands the Web3 Executor: one vault-metered action, unsigned until Phase 7 signs it.

FeedbackEvent.title: FeedbackEvent
FeedbackEvent.description: One review signal. `event_id` makes learning idempotent (e.g. tx hash + log index, or record id + kind).

entity.title: Entity
entity.description: The name that matched in the headline

is_insolvency_trigger.title: Is Insolvency Trigger
is_insolvency_trigger.description: Whether headline contains a structural insolvency trigger

rationale.title: Rationale
rationale.description: Short: it is written on-chain in AutonomousRadiusAdjusted

LeverState.title: LeverState
LeverState.description: What the Brain knows about the vault's levers for one account (Phase 7 reads it from TetherGuardHook).

Mandate.title: Mandate
Mandate.description: A user's request, parsed into typed form.

venue_id.title: Venue Id
venue_id.description: Pin one specific venue; omit to let Agent 2 pick the best fit for this asset/action

OptionRequest.title: OptionRequest
OptionRequest.description:
One predefined, pre-approved action — never free text. `option_id` is the UI's own label, echoed back
so the frontend can match a result row to the card it rendered, and is never interpreted as an instruction.

Personalization.title: Personalization
Personalization.description: What the BrainProfile changed or predicts at draft time — all shown to the user before they confirm.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Optional breaking headline for the NLP Risk Sentinel

text.title: Text
text.description: Free text order. Omit when draft_id is set.

draft_id.title: Draft Id
draft_id.description: A confirmed draft from /api/mandate/confirm (preferred). Its locked Mandate runs exactly as confirmed, once; `text` is ignored when this is set.

cvar_95.title: Cvar 95
cvar_95.description: Average loss in the worst 5% of years, fraction (negative = gain)

ScoreBreakdown.title: ScoreBreakdown
ScoreBreakdown.description: Every term of score = excess − (1+λ)·PD·LGD − c_in − c_out_stress + w_a·a, fractions per year.

Signal.title: Signal
Signal.description: A review signal: an on-chain Morning Review event or an explicit UI choice (BRAIN_DESIGN §3.2).

VaultIn.title: VaultIn
VaultIn.description: What the UI knows about the vault today (Phase 7 reads it from TetherGuardHook instead).

approval_posterior.title: Approval Posterior
approval_posterior.description: Beta posterior mean α/(α+β) of your past approvals

observations.title: Observations
observations.description: Signals learned for this venue (0 = no history, prior only)
